name: PACE-Bench
intro: PACE-Bench 是 PACE 框架针对四个昂贵 Agent 目标自动选择出的具体代理基准。它在严格留一模型验证中，利用 14 个模型在 19 个低成本非 Agent 基准上的实例级得分，结合目标相关性与全局杠杆度，构建每个目标约 100 个带权来源实例的代理，用于预测绝对得分和模型排序。
org: Carnegie Mellon University; Salesforce AI Research
build_method: 模型留一验证, SVD杠杆度与目标相关性筛选, Local/Global代理回归集成
metric: MAE, Spearman correlation, pairwise ranking accuracy
modality: 文本, 代码, 图像
eval_feature: 四个目标专用代理, 约100实例预算, 绝对得分与成对排序预测
scale: 4个目标代理文件（每个约100个带权来源实例）, 19个来源候选基准, 14个模型
build_method_en: Leave-one-model-out Validation, SVD Leverage and Target-relevance Selection, Local/Global Proxy Regression Ensemble
eval_feature_en: Four Target-specific Proxies, Approximately 100-instance Budget, Absolute-score and Pairwise-ranking Prediction
intro_en: PACE-Bench is the concrete proxy benchmark automatically produced by PACE for four expensive agentic targets. Under strict leave-one-model-out validation, it combines instance-level scores from 14 models on 19 low-cost non-agentic benchmarks with target relevance and global leverage, yielding an approximately 100-instance weighted proxy for each target to predict absolute scores and model rankings.
scale_en: 4 target proxy files (about 100 weighted source instances each), 19 candidate source benchmarks, 14 models
metric_en: MAE, Spearman correlation, pairwise ranking accuracy
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2607.02032 and the official neulab/pace code and pace-bench dataset card. The diagrams distinguish the PACE selection framework from its concrete four-target PACE-Bench output; preserve 14 models, 4 agentic targets, 19 candidate source benchmarks, 11 capabilities, OpenHands Index target evaluation, strict leave-one-model-out calibration, target-instance bootstrap, thin SVD, leverage and absolute Spearman signals, separate C_L Local and C_G Global paths with fixed-ratio replenishment after overlap until C=100 unique instances, separate projections, linear absolute-score and logistic pairwise regressions, lambda ensembling, serialized weighted target files, and MAE, Spearman, pairwise accuracy, and cost results.
